visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair is sitting comfortably on a white fabric-covered sofa in a minimalist living room. He is wearing a beige and brown horizontal-striped sweater, blue jeans, and black slippers with red accents. He holds a smartphone in his hands, focused on the screen, while a bright red heart-shaped pillow rests on his lap. (2) A young woman with long, straight black hair wearing a tight light blue mini-dress enters the frame from the left. She approaches the man and reaches down to take his phone. The background features floor-to-ceiling beige curtains and a white modern egg-style chair. (3) The woman removes the phone from his grasp and picks up the red heart-shaped pillow from his lap, placing it on the floor. She then kneels on the pillow, looking up at the man, who appears slightly surprised by her actions. The lighting is bright and even across the room. (4) The woman leans forward and rests her head on the man's lap, adjusting her position for comfort. The man looks down at her and smiles as she settles in. He begins to gently stroke her long hair with his right hand as they maintain this intimate pose. (5) She sits more upright on the floor between his legs while still leaning against the sofa. He continues to play with her hair, looking down at her with a gentle expression. The scene remains static with a warm, domestic atmosphere until the end of the clip.
